groups.contract: Authored dialogue cardinality, selection and effect declarations preserve runtime admission boundaries
groups.disposition: All exact authored bodies personally read, including the previously unread organizations tail and separately reread services truncation gap. No parser/runtime execution. Players min1/max4 and single NPC roles, integer priorities and yes/no/single modes are ordinary finite authored values. Majority example and first_response apprenticeship make different explicit resolution policies. Content performs no numeric accumulation itself. Actual dialogue build/runtime admission and participant/result resolution remain dependencies; author declarations do not independently prove checked runtime transitions.

groups.contract: Dialogue effect success statements require actual effect application before published result turns
groups.disposition: Join, dues payment, promotion request, organization presentation, apprenticeship, contract acceptance/reporting, faith flag, referred testimony and investigation return/expose are explicit effect ports. Content branches use fact states and priorities, but statements such as reward settled/new role recorded are result turns whose truth depends on runtime/effect/reducer success and rollback contracts already under audit. Missing conditions on return/expose are not proof of unauthorized mutation because actual reducer authority is required. Decline/wait branches intentionally omit effects. No content-only new defect or independent transaction guarantee promoted.
